title: Scientists were wrong about this strange mammal for nearly 40 years

Tamirkhan balcarceli shows that zhelestids were not early relatives of modern placental mammals, despite having teeth that seemed to suggest they were. Instead, the rabbit-like animal belonged to a separate lineage of small Cretaceous mammals.

title: James Webb reveals why planet formation is a race against time

title: Pomegranate compound improves heart function by up to 80% in study

title: Scientists found a surprising driver of Alzheimer’s outside the brain

title: Resetting the body clock could help the brain recover after stroke
